answer: Make every identity grow like a pearl: a new agent starts with a thin shell — a small locked bond and a low earning cap — and adds one layer per epoch of honest, attested work, so reputation is slow, layered, and costly to fake in bulk. Identities live on island trust domains; an island crowded with fresh identities faces a shared cap, and moving islands requires re-bonding from scratch, so a Sybil farm cannot flood one market. Honest attestations earn saffron credits — scarce, non-transferable, spent to vouch for newcomers — and a bad vouch burns the voucher's saffron and bond.
